text: Background of Financial Technology and Smart Contracts reports that FinTech smart-contract research concentrates on security, scalability, legal-regulatory, privacy, and latency challenges, with proposed solutions still far from effective. This independently corresponds to Kaal's identification of regulatory uncertainty around blockchain and smart contracts, while showing that the uncertainty sits among broader technical constraints. The proposition does not establish that legal frameworks worldwide must change.
